              program corrects multiplier used to calculate wind 
              direction. 
 
 
07/11/2008: Station Maintenance: 
 
            - General station maintenance and system checks, including: 
 
              - Logger was temporary disable during system maintenace 
                which lead to a brief period of missing data. 
 
              - Replacement of wind vane (i.e. wind direction) with 
                a new and calibrated sensor. 
 
              - Soil Moisture sensors now installed vertically: 
                    - MSTR 0:  profile of depth =  0 - 12" 
                    - MSTR 1:  profile of depth = 12 - 24" 
         
            - Work was done approx: 1030 - 1115 (Day=193)
